component.name: YetEase Music
网易云音乐Yet
component.summary: 网易云音乐第三方客户端

description.p: YetEase Music is a fast, clean third-party client for NetEase Cloud Music. A native Rust core handles networking, decoding, caching and lyrics, and a Flutter interface follows the look and feel of the official desktop and tablet apps.
网易云音乐Yet 是一个快速、干净、好看的网易云音乐第三方客户端。网络、解码、缓存与歌词由原生 Rust 内核处理， 界面用 Flutter 绘制，布局与细节参照官方桌面版和平板版。

ul.li: QR-code login; playlists, likes, daily picks and play history synced with your phone
扫码登录，歌单、喜欢、每日推荐与听歌记录与手机同步
Discover, playlist square, charts, podcasts, albums and artists
发现音乐、歌单广场、排行榜、播客、专辑与歌手页
Stream while downloading, with a size-capped offline cache, up to Hi-Res quality
边下边播，带容量上限的离线缓存，最高支持 Hi-Res 音质
Word-by-word lyrics with translations, and a transparent desktop lyrics overlay
逐字歌词与翻译，透明桌面歌词
Song comments, downloads with embedded tags, and a local music library
歌曲评论、带标签与封面的下载、本地音乐
Media keys and desktop media controls through MPRIS
通过 MPRIS 支持媒体键与桌面媒体控件
Light and dark themes, interface scaling and an overseas network mode
浅色与深色主题、界面缩放、海外网络模式

description.p: The app talks to NetEase's own API directly, with no third-party server in between, and has no ads or telemetry. Only NetEase's own audio sources are used, so VIP tracks follow your account's entitlements.
应用直接连接网易云官方接口，不经过任何第三方服务器，没有广告，也不收集任何数据。只使用网易云自己的音源， VIP 歌曲按你账号的权益播放。
YetEase Music is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with NetEase, Inc. or NetEase Cloud Music.
本应用是非官方客户端，与网易公司及网易云音乐无关。

screenshot.caption: Now playing, with a cover-tinted backdrop and synced lyrics

description.p: A new flat app icon, and an interface aligned with the new official NetEase web player: a unified colour palette with the official red gradient, official sidebar and song row sizing, instant hover feedback, and a gradient search box.
The system text size now scales the whole interface, so large text no longer gets clipped. The sidebar can be resized by dragging, and the player bar shows a placeholder when nothing is playing.
System tray: closing the window keeps the music playing; reopen or quit from the tray. Starting the app again brings back the existing window.
Flatpak packaging metadata. No functional changes for desktop users.
Fixes silent playback on Android and logs crashes in background threads.
Fixes a blank screen on Android startup.
Installers for every platform, system media controls, word-by-word and desktop lyrics, album, artist and chart pages, a terminal UI and log export.
